 The Department of Justice (Department or DOJ), Security and Emergency Planning Staff (SEPS) is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to seek information regarding industry capabilities to provide modernization and enhancements to a 24/7 crisis management and communications center. Vendors should provide details on enhancing capabilities into a modern state-of-the-art facility suitable for executive level staff and their guests and increasing situational awareness capabilities. Vendors should also provide details on services they can provide for 24/7 operational centers. The DOJ is reviewing the marketplace to proactively examine all available options to ensure that the Department’s technology investments deliver maximum value, flexibility, and innovation today, and into the future. 

  Project Name: Justice Command Center Phase II Renovation  
 
 Background:  
The Justice Command Center (JCC) is a secure 24-hour facility operating in support of law enforcement and national security programs. The JCC is the primary information gathering and crisis management facility for the Attorney General (AG) and senior Department officials; it is designed to function during routine operations and emergencies. The last renovations to the JCC were in 2006 and consisted of minor cosmetic improvements. The JCC needs major renovations to continue to provide the best service possible to the Departmental leadership. 

  Objectives:  
The Department of Justice Command Center modernization encompasses the renovation and upgrade of the JCC suite, which currently comprises three (3) conference rooms, one (1) watch floor, two (2) IT server rooms, two (2) restrooms, and one (1) storage room. The renovation shall deliver the following enhancements: upgrades to existing conference rooms to modern standards suitable for executive-level meetings and high-level briefings, modern design elements and finishes, renovation of the watch floor to support advanced situational awareness and real-time operational collaboration, and upgrades to all common areas and support spaces to contemporary standards while maintaining compliance with all security and operational requirements. Upon completion, the renovations shall provide a modern environment that is suitable for executive level staff and supports the JCC’s mission as the primary information gathering and crisis management center for senior Department officials. 

  Miscellaneous Requirements:  

  Security:  
1. Contractors must be able to pass National Crime Information Center (NCIC) background check for building access. The JCC is a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF), therefore no devices with Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, photography, and/or recording capabilities are permitted within the JCC. 
 
2. All visitors to the Restricted Area build site will be escorted/monitored by cleared personnel. 

  Availability:  
The JCC is a 24/7 operation; however, work should be done after normal business hours (1800 – 0600) to limit disruptions to Department leadership. 

  Compliance:  
1. Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 705; 
2. ICD 705-1 Technical Specifications; and 
3. TEMPEST Countermeasures. 

  Tasks:  

  Room 1:  
1. Executive level conference table with DOJ seal engraved in center of the table 
2. Enhanced appearance with new drywall, fresh paint, and decor; and 
3. New desk to match conference room table with enough space for four (4); and enclaves, one (1) keyboard, one (1) mouse, two (2) monitors, and one (1) KVM; and 
4. Unclassified Telephone Security Group (TSG) 6 approved speaker phone 
5. Hidden but easily accessible cable raceway; and 
6. New executive level furniture to include credenza,, and end tables; and 
7. TotalMass MassLoaded Vinyl (MLV) Barrier (sounds dampening material which meets Sound Transmission Class (STC) 50 sound attenuation requirements); and 
8. Replace existing carpet with new carpet tiles (unique to AG Conference Room space) 

  Room 2:  
1. Modernized appearance with new drywall, fresh paint, and updated decorative lighting (sconces); and 
2. Updated Department of Justice and/or Justice Command Center Wall Signage; and 
3. Dedicated workspaces (2) which allow for up to four (4) enclaves, one (1) keyboard, one (1) mouse, two (2) monitors, and one (1) KVM; and 
4. Additional seating along walls; and 
5. New podium (reduced size to accommodate video wall) with three (3) JCON enclaves; and 
6. TotalMass MLV Barrier (sounds dampening material which meets STC-50 sound attenuation requirements). 

  Room 3:  
1. Executive level conference table for up to six (6) people; and 
2. New 60” credenza to accommodate IT equipment and wiring; and 
3. One (1) desk with three (3) enclaves; and 
4. Executive level chairs; and 
5. Enhanced appearance with new drywall and fresh paint; and 
6. Match carpet tiles to existing floor in the JCC suite; and 
7. New LED lighting and ceiling tiles; and 
8. Two 75” 4k LED monitors. 

  Room 4:  
1. Collaborative layout desks for the Watch Officers; and 
2. Dedicated workspace for the Lead Emergency Actions Specialist and Lead Telecommunication Specialist within the watch floor (Two Leads, Two Watch Officers); and 
3. New 24/7 high durability desk chairs (5 chairs total); and 
4. Printer Cove with three (3) printers (GFE); and 
5. Built-in cabinetry for storage and binders; and
